summary: Config-driven, deterministic PC12A engine skeleton built and smoke-tested with NO PnL anywhere in dry-run output (RGC-INC-1). Modules: panels.py (.bi5 loader, lzma + >u4x5+>f4 per the pinned audit format, divisors 1e5/1e5/1e3, BID/ASK pairing, per-day cache, coverage assertions incl. OHLC invariant + negative-spread trip); calendar_service.py (286-Friday calendar 2021-01-08..2026-06-26, 52w warmup + 8x26w test folds + 1w train-side embargo + 26w sealed tail EXCLUDED, tzdata-rebuilt London/NY session marks with DST-seam tests, Wednesday-x3 swap calendar with 22:00 UTC boundary, roll/reopen windows with the tzdata-rebuilt Sunday-reopen instant at 17:00 America/New_York); cost_kernel.py (C1/C2-Fri/C3 cells + the Lane-D CORRECTED C2 Mon-Thu cells as GOVERNING with dual-source doc comments and a machine-readable citation map, U2/U3/U4-U5 declared bands, stress tiers 1.0/1.5/2.0, spread-once ordinary + worst-fill-graded + window-cell fill pricing, tier-scaled per spec 5); journal.py (append-only hash-chained journal_row@1 writer, tamper-detecting verify_chain, corrections-as-new-rows, frozen outcome enum, ONOFF counterfactual-twin rows per GROUPING_PROPOSAL 4.2 without any would-PnL field in dry-run surfaces); books.py ($100k book identity with UNAVAILABLE fail-closed + the FillAccountingEngine that REPRODUCES ALL SIX FIXTURES fx1..fx6 at 1e-9 incl. timeline event labels, fills, swap lines, virtual netting attribution and the section-6 decomposition invariant, plus stress-sweep proportionality); legs.py (identity-tuple configs, the 9 VOLPROF class candidates per CLASS_SPEC r2 frozen constructions - BID-side size-weighted profile, 20-trading-day lookback with the >=360-tradable-minute day rule, 0.25xATR20d bins quantized down to the 0.1-pip grid, POC tie->lowest, VA70 greedy tie->up, P20/P80, LVN runs bounded both sides, Friday-20:00 freeze truncated AT the stamp, London-union-NY entry windows, flat-by-19:55 with a defensive forced-flat path, 60-min cooldown; plus 3 exemplar corpus legs USDJPY-S001 Donchian-20/55 D1, GBPUSD-S027 weekday meta-gate, EURUSD-S009 MACD-H exhaustion exit with its T2 declared defaults frozen in the config); policy.py (L1-L7 skeleton: E1/E3/E4 eligibility on pre-trade features only with FEATURES_BLACKLIST enforcing GROUPING_PROPOSAL 3.6, L4 netting with +/-1-lot truncation and NETTED_TO_ZERO ties, L5 cluster caps on a frozen PLACEHOLDER map, L6 cost guard with risk-reducing-close carve-out, L7 W1/W4 typed); run_dry.py (CLI --legs/--window/--out/--tier; streams the read-only audited panels day-by-day; writes the hash-chained journal + DRY_RUN_REPORT.json carrying ONLY decision counts, vote distributions, fill counts by outcome, blocked-reason histogram, cost-bill totals by component, journal row count, elapsed and code/data digests; greps its own output for forbidden keys and FAILS the run on any hit). Tests: 82 pc12a tests green via the root .venv pytest incl. synthetic .bi5 round-trips, DST seam fixtures, cost cells vs audit_summary.json, fx1..fx6 equality at 1e-9 consumed from the control dir, hash-chain tamper detection, book identities, FEATURES_BLACKLIST enforcement, synthetic-panel dry-run determinism (byte-identical journals) and the leak scan. Real-panel smoke: 8 weeks 2024-01-05..2024-02-23, all 12 legs, 3 pairs, tier 1.0 - 965 journal rows, chain verified, leak scan CLEAN, elapsed 12.4s; two independent real-panel runs produced BYTE-IDENTICAL journals. No PnL/PF/Sharpe/equity field exists anywhere in the dry-run outputs.
